Fun. Any cuisine or budget in mind?
Nothing too pricey. Also, I'm allergic to peanuts myself, carry an EpiPen and everything, so please no satay or Thai places.
Noted, nothing with peanuts for you. How about a Japanese set lunch place? Most do mains around $15.
Ethan's birthday party is next Saturday. I want to bake a cake he can actually eat. Any ideas?
An egg-free chocolate cake works well. Oil, vinegar and baking soda do the job eggs normally do. Want the recipe?
Yes please, keep it simple. I bake maybe twice a year.
Mix flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda and salt, then add oil, vinegar and water. Bake at 180°C for about 30 minutes.

Set a timer to stand every hour, take calls on your feet, and use the stairs instead of the lift.

Try wholemeal toast with eggs, or unsweetened Greek yoghurt with nuts. Both are kinder to your blood sugar than kaya toast.
